analysis_runs_completed_result_validated.name: analysis_runs_completed_result_validated
analysis_runs_completed_result_validated.value: "analysis_runs"."status" <> 'completed' or ("analysis_runs"."validated_result_at" is not null and "analysis_runs"."provider_response_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "analysis_runs"."provider" is not null and "analysis_runs"."adapter_version" is not null and "analysis_runs"."completed_at" is not null)

audit_events_actor_matches_origin.name: audit_events_actor_matches_origin

document_versions_pasted_text_consistent.name: document_versions_pasted_text_consistent
document_versions_pasted_text_consistent.value:
"document_versions"."content_text" is null or (
        "document_versions"."capture_method" = 'pasted_text' and
        "document_versions"."media_type" = 'text/plain' and
        "document_versions"."processing_status" = 'ready' and
        "document_versions"."storage_object_key" is null and
        "document_versions"."byte_size" = octet_length("document_versions"."content_text")
      )

evidence_references_quote_offsets_consis.name: evidence_references_quote_offsets_consistent
evidence_references_quote_offsets_consis.value:
(
        "evidence_references"."quoted_text" is null and "evidence_references"."start_offset" is null and "evidence_references"."end_offset" is null
      ) or (
        "evidence_references"."quoted_text" is not null and length("evidence_references"."quoted_text") > 0 and
        (("evidence_references"."start_offset" is null and "evidence_references"."end_offset" is null) or
         ("evidence_references"."start_offset" >= 0 and "evidence_references"."end_offset" > "evidence_references"."start_offset"))
      )

provider_claim_results_probability_range.name: provider_claim_results_probability_range
provider_claim_results_probability_range.value: "provider_claim_results"."weight" >= 0 and "provider_claim_results"."supported" between 0 and 1 and "provider_claim_results"."contradicted" between 0 and 1 and "provider_claim_results"."not_stated" between 0 and 1 and "provider_claim_results"."not_a_claim" between 0 and 1

provider_claim_results_evidence_consiste.name: provider_claim_results_evidence_consistent
provider_claim_results_evidence_consiste.value:
(
        "provider_claim_results"."evidence_document_version_id" is null and "provider_claim_results"."evidence_quote" is null and
        "provider_claim_results"."evidence_start_offset" is null and "provider_claim_results"."evidence_end_offset" is null and
        "provider_claim_results"."evidence_confidence" is null
      ) or (
        "provider_claim_results"."evidence_document_version_id" is not null and length("provider_claim_results"."evidence_quote") > 0 and
        "provider_claim_results"."evidence_start_offset" >= 0 and "provider_claim_results"."evidence_end_offset" > "provider_claim_results"."evidence_start_offset" and
        "provider_claim_results"."evidence_confidence" between 0 and 1
      )
